The displayed route establishes all clauses with the recorded routine background. Iteration of M009 at ∞, followed by smooth fixed-vector evaluation, gives all finite partials smooth on Ω. M002 and the checked coordinate/Fréchet bridge give the required mixed equality. Smooth inner products and finite sums make e smooth, and M009 gives smooth e_t, hence both are continuous. Differentiating u·u=1 using M001 gives 2u·u_t=0; this is valid at every interior point before the identity is differentiated again. H005 supplies a local normal multiplier, and finite dot-product algebra gives u_t·(a u)=0 without differentiating a. The time differentiation of u·u_t=0 gives u·u_tt=−|u_t|². Twice differentiating the spatial unit constraint gives u·u_{x_jx_j}=−|u_{x_j}|². Dotting the normality equation with u therefore yields exactly a=Σ_j|u_{x_j}|²−|u_t|². Finally M001 differentiates each energy term; mixed symmetry and finite-sum differentiation give the exported formula with coefficient 2 and the stated order of partials. Time neighborhoods can be chosen inside t>0; no endpoint regularity is used. Empty spatial sums cause no failure when n=0, and there is no division by n, m, u_t, or the multiplier.
